# Ordinary-product regression references

These two seven-day, seed123 projections were captured on Windows only after their canonical JSON hashes matched the previously recorded numeric9 golden hashes in `test_engine_credibility.py`. They contain fictional test data. New credibility metrics are excluded; the engine-version field is projected to numeric9.

The test keeps both exact golden hashes as fixture-integrity anchors. Structure, discrete events, counts and monetary cents are compared exactly. Continuous floating-point values use relative and absolute tolerances of1e-12 to accommodate NumPy platform-build differences. Do not regenerate references to make a failing platform pass. See [NumPy's compatibility policy](https://numpy.org/doc/2.0/reference/random/compatibility.html).
